description: Percussion synthesizer with an oscillator section, a noise section built around a comb filter and a multimode filter, and a modulation router with four slots that can reach any control

params.text: Sets the main pitch of the drum, from C0 to C4
Sets the pitch the oscillator starts from, which together with TIME sets how snappy the sound is
Sets how long the pitch takes to move from the pitch set by BEND to the pitch set by TUNE
Adds a sub oscillator for a deeper sound, despite the panel printing OSC 2
Moves the oscillator wave from a pure sine to a harmonically richer triangle
Applies one of two kinds of distortion to the oscillator
Sets the rising rate of the oscillator envelope
Sets the time the oscillator envelope stays at its maximum
Sets the rate at which the oscillator envelope returns to 0V
Picks the oscillator envelope: SOFT for longer transitions, HARD for a snappier one, LOOP for repeats that suit snare sounds
Blends the internal oscillator with the signal at the oscillator section's EXT jack
Sets the output level of the oscillator section
Sets the frequency of the comb filter ripples in the noise, which is what gives it a metallic sound
Sets the comb applied to the noise to positive or negative, one giving a lower sound and the other a brighter one
Sets the character of the noise: counter-clockwise a pink-like noise that suits snares, clockwise a noise without low frequencies that suits hi hats
Sets the cutoff frequency of the filter applied to the noise
Emphasises the frequencies around the noise filter's cutoff, for a more tuned noise
Picks the response of the noise filter: LP, BP or HP
Sets the rising rate of the noise envelope
Sets the time the noise envelope stays at its maximum
Sets the rate at which the noise envelope returns to 0V
Picks the noise envelope: SOFT for longer transitions, HARD for a snappier one, LOOP for repeats that suit snare sounds
Blends the internal noise with the signal at the noise section's EXT jack
Sets the output level of the noise section
Attenuates and inverts the modulation input of the same number before it reaches the control assigned to that slot
Assigns that modulation slot: press it, then move the control the slot should change

inputs.text: A signal above 2V triggers both sections
An external oscillator to blend into the oscillator section
An external signal to blend into the noise section
A control voltage for the control assigned to the modulation slot of the same number
A gate that triggers the oscillator section on its own
A gate that triggers the noise section on its own

outputs.text: The pitch CV of the internal oscillator, shaped by BEND, for driving an external oscillator whose signal comes back into EXT
The envelope of the oscillator section
The envelope of the noise section
The audio of the oscillator section on its own
The audio of the noise section on its own

notes: a modulation input does nothing until its slot is assigned: press the slot's button, then move the control the slot should change
menu: Rand. Oscillator — lets the randomize command touch the oscillator section: tune, bend, time, sub, wave, shaper, its envelope and its level
Rand. Noise — lets the randomize command touch the noise section: pitch, rescomb, tone, the filter cutoff, resonance and type, its envelope and its level
Rand. Modulation — lets the randomize command touch the amounts of the four modulation slots
